history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, messy hair and sunglasses is sitting on a black scooter at night. He is wearing a plain white t-shirt and black pants with a silver cross emblem on the right leg. The scooter has a digital dashboard displaying the number "18888" in red and green lights. There are stickers on the scooter, including one with a skull and crossbones design and another circular sticker with the letter "a" in a circle. The background is dark and appears to be a street scene with trees, streetlights, and a billboard in the distance. The lighting is dim and atmospheric, with the scooter's dashboard and the man's face illuminated. The overall mood is cool and urban, with a hint of mystery due to the nighttime setting. The color palette is dominated by dark tones with pops of red and green from the scooter's lights and the silver of the man's jewelry and emblem. The style is realistic with a slightly gritty, street-style aesthetic.
